drift.verdict: ZERO drift both directions: all 85 swagger operations map to a live controller action and all 85 controller actions appear in swagger (route+method matched after normalizing {param:constraint} templates).

mechanism.export: Backend/scripts/export-swagger:22-31 builds the API in Release and runs the Swashbuckle CLI (dotnet swagger tofile) against the built DLL from the publish output, writing directly to Frontend/quran-dashboard-ui/openapi/swagger.json; startup permission-catalogue sync is disabled during generation (Access__PermissionCatalogueStartupSync__Enabled=false) so spec export never mutates a database.
mechanism.verification: Backend/scripts/check-api-contract:7-24 re-runs export-swagger, regenerates the frontend client (npm run generate:api), then fails (exit 1) if git diff shows any change under Frontend/quran-dashboard-ui/openapi or src/app/core/api/generated — i.e. the committed spec+client must always match the code.
mechanism.freshness_caveat: The mechanism is on-demand (script), not a CI hook found in this inventory; swagger.json is only as fresh as the last check-api-contract run. Zero drift measured at HEAD confirms it was run after the last API change.

source.note: Direct entity projection (id, sectionId, parentId, name, description, representativeAyahText, orderValue, globalOrderValue, version) + computed isDeleted/childCount/relationsCount/aliases.

Assembled from 4 sequential queries: sections, ALL doors (incl. soft-deleted), aliases grouped by door, live relation pairs; child/section/relation counts computed in memory; version = max UpdatedAtUtc/DeletedAtUtc across 3 tables (3 more MaxAsync queries).
Entity projection + in-memory live door count.
AccessAuditEvents with ActorUser/TargetUser includes; uses raw SQL for cursor paging; snapshot/state fields are stored JSON.
AccessUsers with UserPermissions->Permission includes; permissionCount computed.
MutashabihatGroups + occurrences + ayah/surah context; word-level highlight ranges hydrated from QuranWords.

Ayah + Surah include; tafsir/translation/fullI3rab resolved by joining source tables with per-ayah entry tables; similarity summary from SimilarAyahLinks (both directions) + MutashabihatOccurrences group count.
Raw SQL over quran_lemmas joined to morphology/words; counts aggregated in SQL.

Lines query + words query (projection incl. Ayah navigation-property join for verseKey/juz/hizb/rub) + surah-name lookup + marker union query (juz/hizb/rub via Concat) + separate sajda query; navigation summary and surah ayah-ranges computed in memory.
Projection from QuranWords row (location, verseKey, wordNumber, lineWordOrder, textUthmani, isAyahMarker).
Raw SQL over quran_roots joined to morphology/words; counts aggregated in SQL.
SimilarAyahLinks (both directions) joined to QuranAyahs with Surah include.
Raw SQL over quran_stems joined to segments/pos tags/words; counts aggregated in SQL.
Raw SQL over quran_words_unique_{simple|tashkeel} with joins to morphology winners (root/pos tag); occurrence/ayah/surah counts aggregated in SQL (COUNT(*) OVER() window paging).
Word row joined against ordered/unique word tables (simple+tashkeel), morphology, segments, pos tags, roots/lemmas/stems, i3rab rules (~10 joined tables).
Raw SQL (large CTE pipeline: base/winners/grouped) over quran_word_morphology + words + pos tags + lemma/root/stem winners.

payload_estimates.basis: Per-door ~250-600 B (Arabic name/representativeAyahText are \uXXXX-escaped at 6 B/char by the default System.Text.Json encoder; ~10 scalar fields + aliases). Response includes ALL doors including soft-deleted ones (EfAbwabTreeReader.cs:15-17). Door count is content data not asserted anywhere in code or tests.
83,668 words / 604 pages = ~139 words/page avg (ImportCountsTests.cs:41); ~150-250 B/word JSON (6 fields incl. escaped Uthmani text) + 15 lines + markers + navigation.
Dominated by tafsir/translation/i3rab entry text lengths (long escaped Arabic prose); row counts per ayah are 1 per selected source but text length unbounded.
Group count x occurrences x ayah text previews; distribution of mutashabihat group sizes not asserted in code.
SimilarAyahLinks per ayah with full ayah texts (escaped Arabic); link fan-out not asserted in code.
Single word: identity + morphology + segments + rendered segments; bounded structure, ~40-80 fields total.
Fixed 114 surahs (ImportCountsTests.cs:37) x ~8 fields incl. escaped Arabic name (~150 B/item).
DefaultListPageSize = 1000 (UniqueWordsController.cs:21); 11 fields/item, 2 escaped Arabic strings (~30-60 B each escaped) => ~250-400 B/item x 1000.
DefaultListPageSize = 1000 (WordTypesController.cs:24); 13 fields/item with 5+ escaped Arabic strings => ~350-550 B/item.
Same 1000-row default, polymorphic row DTO (WordTypeTableRowDto oneOf variants).
Fixed POS taxonomy (dozens of nodes with Arabic labels + counts); node count is data-derived.
Paged (AccessUserPaging.DefaultPageSize, bounded by MaximumPageSize — AccessUsersController.cs:32-33); 9 fields/item, small user population.
Cursor-paged, pageSize default 25 (AccessAuditEventsController.cs:22); 17 fields/item incl. unbounded JSON snapshot/state/metadata fields.

notes: AUTH MODEL (CONFIRMED): No fallback authorization policy and no global AuthorizeFilter (Backend/api/QuranDashboard.Api/Authentication/AuthenticationRegistration.cs:51, Backend/api/QuranDashboard.Api/Extensions/ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs:20), so every endpoint without an attribute is anonymous. Distribution: 51 anonymous (all GETs outside Access), 21 permission:<code>, 12 owner, 1 authenticated (GET /api/access/me). Every unsafe method (POST/PUT/DELETE) is forced at startup to carry exactly one [RequirePermission] or [RequireOwner] by UnsafeEndpointMetadataValidator (Backend/api/QuranDashboard.Api/Authorization/Validation/UnsafeEndpointMetadataValidator.cs:34-99), which also rejects unknown permission codes against AbwabPermissionCatalogue.

RESPONSE ENVELOPE (CONFIRMED): every operation returns ApiResponse<T> {isSuccess, message, data, errors}; message is Arabic. Model-binding failures are rewritten into the same envelope (ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs:25-33).

JSON ENCODING (LIKELY): no AddJsonOptions/JavaScriptEncoder configuration exists anywhere in the API project (grep over Backend/api returned none), so System.Text.Json's default encoder escapes all non-ASCII: every Arabic character serializes as \uXXXX (6 bytes). For this Arabic-first product that inflates most payloads several-fold; all payload estimates above assume escaped output. Needs runtime confirmation of actual bytes on the wire.

CACHING (CONFIRMED): two layers. (1) IMemoryCache decorators: 14 Cached* reader decorators (abwab tree, abwab templates, mushaf page, surah catalog, study-source catalog, word analysis, ayah study, similarities, mutashabihat, unique words, word types, roots, lemmas, stems) plus 5 Invalidating* abwab writer decorators, all under Backend/infrastructure/QuranDashboard.Infrastructure/Caching/. (2) HTTP ETag conditional GET (304) only on abwab tree and templates endpoints via IAbwabCacheValidators + ConditionalGet. NO [ResponseCache]/output caching attributes exist on any controller (grep over Controllers returned none).

PAGINATION SHAPE (CONFIRMED): three shapes coexist — PagedResult{page,pageSize,totalCount,items} for words explorers, AccessUserSummaryPagedResult (same shape) for access users, cursor-based AccessAuditEventPage{items,nextCursor} for audit events. Word-explorer list endpoints default to pageSize=1000 (DefaultListPageSize — UniqueWordsController.cs:21, RootsController.cs:27, StemsController.cs:25, WordTypesController.cs:24); detail drill-downs default to 100.
RATE LIMITING (CONFIRMED): global partitioned fixed-window limiter over all endpoints with a separate health partition (Backend/api/QuranDashboard.Api/RateLimiting/RateLimitingRegistration.cs:26-67).

CANONICAL ROW COUNTS (CONFIRMED, from Backend/tests/QuranDashboard.Tests/Quran/Import/ImportCountsTests.cs:26-43): 114 surahs, 6,236 ayahs, 604 pages, 9,046 mushaf lines, 83,668 words (77,432 readable + 6,236 ayah markers). Morphology-table counts (roots/lemmas/stems/unique words) are not asserted anywhere in code or tests — NEEDS_MEASUREMENT.

TESTS COLUMN (LIKELY): per-endpoint test lists are a best-effort static grep matching controller class name, handler class name, or route regex inside Backend/tests/QuranDashboard.Tests; a file listed may exercise only some of a controller's actions. Every operation matched at least 2 test files (median 4, max 13). SmokeRouteCatalog.cs + SmokeRouteBaselineTests.cs pin the route inventory itself.

OPERATION IDS (CONFIRMED): the swagger spec contains no operationId fields; the generated frontend client derives names structurally. operationId values in this inventory are synthesized as 'METHOD /route'.

WRITE-PATH SCOPE: 27 non-GET operations (18 POST, 4 PUT, 5 DELETE) all live in Abwab (21, permission-classified) and Access (6, owner-classified); their data paths are Ef*Writer/mutation services (see per-endpoint data_path).

HEAVY-TIER SELECTION: 17 endpoints flagged heavy_tier=true (abwab tree, 6 mushaf reader reads, 7 words-explorer lists/trees, access users/audit/permission grid) received deep data-path + payload treatment; the remaining 68 are shallow by design.
